clues: This huge city sits on a river in the east of Europe. It is the most crowded city that lies wholly on that continent.
Winters here are long and cold, lasting from the middle of fall to the end of March. Snow lies on the ground for about five months each year.
The capital left this city for a fresh city in 1712, then came back here in 1918. It has stayed the seat of power ever since that return.
Saint Basil's Cathedral was built in 1561 by the great square at the heart of this city. It is a famed showpiece of the old building style here.
The Kremlin is an old walled fort in this city. It is the seat of power for the rulers of Russia.
